subject: DI01005021

body.en:
Definition

Thermal insulators reduce heat transfer through a selected material/system; useful classification can be based on structure, chemistry or supplied form.

Classification

  • By structure: fibrous(glass/mineral wool), granular(perlite), cellular(closed/open cells such as suitable foams) and reflective systems with an appropriate air gap.
  • By chemistry: inorganic mineral/glass materials, organic polymer/cellulosic materials and metallic reflective surfaces. These groups overlap the structural classification.
  • By form: blanket, board, preformed pipe section, loose fill or applied system; hot/cold service is another selection basis.

Limitations and precautions

  • Combustibility, smoke, moisture, temperature limit and worker exposure must be checked. Asbestos is not recommended or handled in student work.

Labelled diagram and explanation

Fibres, cells or granules retain small gas spaces. The usable temperature and conductivity depend on actual product, moisture and installation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Thermal insulator પસંદ કરેલી વ્યવસ્થામાં heat transfer ઘટાડે છે; બંધારણ, chemistry કે મળતા form પ્રમાણે વર્ગીકરણ થઈ શકે.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • બંધારણ પ્રમાણે fibrous: glass/mineral wool; granular: perlite; cellular: યોગ્ય foamsમાં open/closed cells; reflective systemમાં યોગ્ય air gap.
  • Chemistry પ્રમાણે inorganic mineral/glass, organic polymer/cellulosic અને metallic reflective surfaces. આ structural classificationથી જુદો આધાર છે.
  • Form પ્રમાણે blanket, board, preformed pipe section, loose fill કે applied system. Hot/cold service અલગ પસંદગીનો આધાર છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • Combustibility, smoke, moisture, temperature limit તથા worker exposure તપાસો. Asbestosની ભલામણ કે student handling કરાવાતી નથી.

નામવાળી આકૃતિ અને સમજણ

Fibres, cells કે granulesમાં નાના gas spaces અટકે. Usable temperature/conductivity actual product, ભેજ તથા installation પર આધારિત.

body.en:
Definition

A suitable insulation system gives the required thermal resistance while remaining mechanically, chemically and environmentally fit for service.

Properties and explanation

  • Low effective k at actual mean temperature; sufficient thermal stability and low unwanted shrinkage.
  • Mechanical strength appropriate to load, dimensional stability, low water uptake and compatible chemistry.
  • Fire/smoke behaviour, ageing, ease of installation, joint integrity and outer protection affect performance.

Applications and selection

  • Hot pipes/vessels: reduce energy loss and limit accessible surface temperature with a verified design.
  • Cold pipes: reduce heat gain and surface condensation; vapour control must prevent moisture ingress.
  • Exterior cladding protects against weather/mechanical damage; insulation is not itself a corrosion barrier.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

યોગ્ય insulation system જરૂરી thermal resistance આપે અને યાંત્રિક, રાસાયણિક તથા વાતાવરણની દૃષ્ટિએ serviceમાં ટકી રહે.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Actual mean temperatureએ ઓછી effective k; યોગ્ય thermal stability અને ઓછું shrinkage.
  • લાગુ ભાર માટે યોગ્ય mechanical strength, dimensional stability, ઓછું water uptake અને compatible chemistry.
  • Fire/smoke behaviour, ageing, installation, joints અને outer protection performanceને અસર કરે.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Hot pipe/vesselમાં energy loss અને યોગ્ય designથી accessible surface temperature ઘટાડે.
  • Cold pipeમાં heat gain/condensation ઘટાડે; vapour controlથી ભેજ પ્રવેશ રોકવો.
  • Outer cladding weather/mechanical damageથી બચાવે; insulation પોતે corrosion barrier નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Effective thermal conductivity combines heat transfer through solid, gas and radiation within a porous insulation at specified conditions.

Factors and their effects

  • Mean temperature: radiation contribution often rises at higher temperatures; use temperature-specific k data.
  • Density: too little solid may increase radiation/gas transfer; excessive compression increases solid conduction. Optimum density is material-specific.
  • Moisture replaces gas and often raises k strongly; pore/cell size, open-cell structure and gas type also matter.
  • Ageing, loss of blowing gas, cracks, settling, fibre orientation and mechanical compression change performance.
  • Thickness increases total resistance R=L/(kA) if k is unchanged; thickness itself is not the same as an intrinsic change of k.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Porous insulationની effective thermal conductivity નિર્ધારિત પરિસ્થિતિમાં solid, gas અને અંદરના radiationના સંયુક્ત heat transferને દર્શાવે છે.

અસર કરતા પરિબળો

  • Mean temperature વધતાં radiation contribution વધે; temperature-specific k data લો.
  • ઓછી densityમાં radiation/gas transfer વધી શકે; વધુ compressionથી solid conduction વધે. Optimum material-specific છે.
  • ભેજ gasની જગ્યા લેતાં k ઘણી વાર વધે; pore/cell size, open-cell structure અને gas type પણ અસર કરે.
  • Ageing, blowing gas નીકળવો, cracks, settling, fibre orientation અને compressionથી performance બદલાય.
  • k સમાન હોય તો જાડાઈ વધવાથી R=L/(kA) વધે; જાડાઈ વધવી અને મૂળ k બદલાવું એક નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Ceramics are inorganic, non-metallic materials commonly made from compounds such as oxides, silicates, carbides or nitrides and consolidated by suitable processing.

Classification

  • Traditional: clay-based brick, tile, porcelain. Engineering: alumina, silicon carbide and silicon nitride examples. Glass is often treated separately although related to inorganic non-metallic materials.

Composition

  • Traditional bodies may contain clay/kaolin, silica and feldspar; engineering ceramics use selected high-purity powders and additives. Composition is product-specific.

Properties and explanation

  • Generally hard, wear-resistant, compression-strong and chemically stable, but brittle with low tensile fracture tolerance.
  • Many are electrical/thermal insulators, but exceptions such as conductive ceramics and thermally conductive SiC exist; thermal shock resistance varies.

Applications and selection

  • Linings, electrical insulators, chemical packing, seals and wear parts; compare chemistry, porosity and thermal shock before selection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ceramics inorganic non-metallic પદાર્થો છે; oxides, silicates, carbides કે nitrides જેવા compoundsથી યોગ્ય પ્રક્રિયા વડે બને છે.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Traditionalમાં clay-based brick, tile, porcelain; engineeringમાં alumina, silicon carbide, silicon nitride. Glass સંબંધિત inorganic non-metallic હોવા છતાં ઘણી વાર અલગ અભ્યાસાય.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • Traditional bodyમાં clay/kaolin, silica, feldspar; engineering ceramicsમાં પસંદ કરેલા high-purity powders/additives. Composition product-specific છે.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • સામાન્ય રીતે hard, wear-resistant, compressionમાં મજબૂત, chemically stable; પણ brittle અને tensile fracture tolerance ઓછી.
  • ઘણા electrical/thermal insulator છે; conductive ceramics તથા thermally conductive SiC અપવાદ છે. Thermal shock resistance બદલાય.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Linings, electrical insulators, chemical packing, seals તથા wear parts; chemistry, porosity અને thermal shock તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

A refractory retains useful physical/chemical integrity at high temperature in the intended furnace or process environment.

Classification

  • By chemical/slag behaviour: acidic(silica), basic(magnesia/doloma) and relatively neutral(high-alumina or carbon in suitable conditions).
  • By form: shaped bricks and unshaped monolithics such as castables; dense working linings and insulating backup materials serve different purposes.

Properties and explanation

  • Refractoriness, hot strength, load-bearing stability, slag/corrosion resistance, controlled porosity and resistance to spalling/thermal cycling matter.
  • Acid/basic labels concern chemical compatibility, not room-temperature pH or simply a higher melting point. Carbon is unsuitable in strongly oxidising service without protection.

Applications and selection

  • Furnace/kiln hot-face linings and process heat equipment; match the refractory with slag chemistry and atmosphere. A dense refractory need not be a good insulator.

Labelled diagram and explanation

The refractory faces the hot chemical environment; backup insulation limits heat loss and the shell supports the assembly. The layers are not interchangeable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Refractory નિર્ધારિત furnace/process વાતાવરણના ઊંચા તાપમાને ઉપયોગી ભૌતિક તથા રાસાયણિક અખંડિતતા જાળવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Chemical/slag વર્તન પ્રમાણે acidic: silica; basic: magnesia/doloma; પ્રમાણમાં neutral: યોગ્ય પરિસ્થિતિમાં high-alumina/carbon.
  • Form પ્રમાણે shaped bricks તથા unshaped monolithics જેમ castable. Dense working lining અને insulating backupનાં કામ જુદાં છે.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Refractoriness, hot strength, load stability, slag/corrosion resistance, યોગ્ય porosity અને thermal-cycle/spalling resistance જોઈએ.
  • Acid/basic chemical compatibility દર્શાવે; રૂમ-તાપમાન pH કે માત્ર melting point નહીં. Carbon strongly oxidising serviceમાં protection વિના યોગ્ય નથી.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Furnace/kilnની hot-face lining તથા process heat equipment; slag chemistry/atmosphere સાથે મેળવો. Dense refractory સારો insulator જ હોય એવું નથી.

નામવાળી આકૃતિ અને સમજણ

Refractory ગરમ chemical atmosphere સામે, backup insulation heat loss ઘટાડે અને shell support આપે. ત્રણે layers પરસ્પર વિકલ્પ નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Soda-lime glass is a common sodium–calcium silicate glass.

Composition

  • Illustrative mass composition: SiO2≈72%, Na2O≈14%, CaO≈10%, other oxides≈4%. Commercial formulations vary.

Properties and explanation

  • Silica forms the network; soda lowers processing viscosity/temperature and lime improves durability. Low cost and transparency but moderate thermal-shock resistance.

Applications and selection

  • Windows, bottles and many ordinary containers.

Limitations and precautions

  • Not a substitute for borosilicate in abrupt thermal cycling or verified chemical service; tempering improves some mechanical behaviour, not universal chemical resistance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Soda-lime glass સામાન્ય sodium–calcium silicate glass છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • ઉદાહરણરૂપ mass composition: SiO2≈72%, Na2O≈14%, CaO≈10%, અન્ય oxides≈4%; commercial formulation બદલાય.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Silica network બનાવે; sodaથી processing viscosity/temperature ઘટે, lime durability સુધારે. સસ્તું અને transparent, પણ thermal-shock resistance મર્યાદિત.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • બારીઓ, bottles તથા સામાન્ય containers.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • અચાનક thermal cycling કે ચકાસેલી chemical serviceમાં borosilicateનો સામાન્ય વિકલ્પ નથી; temperingથી સર્વત્ર chemical resistance મળતી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Borosilicate glass incorporates substantial boron oxide into a silica-based glass network.

Composition

  • A representative nominal mass composition: SiO2≈80.5%, B2O3≈13%, alkali oxides≈4%, Al2O3≈2.5%; exact grade differs.

Properties and explanation

  • Low thermal expansion, good thermal-shock resistance and good resistance to many chemicals relative to ordinary soda-lime glass.

Applications and selection

  • Laboratory glassware, sight components and approved glass process equipment.

Limitations and precautions

  • Still brittle; hydrofluoric acid and strong hot alkalis can attack glass. Temperature/pressure limits are equipment-specific.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Borosilicate glassમાં silica-based network સાથે નોંધપાત્ર boron oxide હોય છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • ઉદાહરણરૂપ nominal mass composition: SiO2≈80.5%, B2O3≈13%, alkali oxides≈4%, Al2O3≈2.5%; grade જુદો હોઈ શકે.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • ઓછું thermal expansion, સારી thermal-shock resistance તથા સામાન્ય soda-lime કરતાં અનેક chemicals સામે સારી resistance.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Laboratory glassware, sight components તથા approved glass process equipment.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • હજી brittle છે; hydrofluoric acid અને ગરમ strong alkali glass પર હુમલો કરે. Temperature/pressure limits equipment-specific છે.

body.en:
Definition

High-silica glass contains a very high silica fraction, including commercial high-silica grades around96% SiO2.

Composition

  • Predominantly SiO2 with small residual oxides. Fused silica is a distinct, still higher-purity silica glass and should not be assumed identical to every96% grade.

Properties and explanation

  • Very low expansion, good thermal-shock capability and high-temperature stability compared with ordinary glass; purity influences optical behaviour.

Applications and selection

  • Special furnace/laboratory parts, thermal windows and selected chemical/optical duties.

Limitations and precautions

  • Cost, brittleness, devitrification and chemical compatibility remain limits; high silica does not mean resistance to HF.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

High-silica glassમાં silicaનું પ્રમાણ ખૂબ વધુ હોય; કેટલીક commercial gradesમાં લગભગ96% SiO2 હોય છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • મુખ્યત્વે SiO2 તથા થોડાં residual oxides. Fused silica વધુ શુદ્ધ અલગ silica glass છે; દરેક96% grade સાથે સમાન ન ગણો.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • સામાન્ય glass કરતાં ખૂબ ઓછું expansion, સારી thermal-shock capability અને high-temperature stability; purityથી optical behaviour બદલાય.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • ખાસ furnace/laboratory parts, thermal windows તથા પસંદ કરેલા chemical/optical કામ.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • ખર્ચ, brittleness, devitrification તથા chemical compatibility મર્યાદા છે; ઊંચી silica એટલે HF સામે resistance નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Glass fibre consists of fine glass filaments used individually or as reinforcement, fabrics and related products.

Composition

  • Silica-based compositions with CaO, Al2O3 and other oxides; traditional E-glass may contain B2O3, while boron-free grades also exist.

Properties and explanation

  • High tensile strength relative to weight, electrically insulating in suitable grades; brittle individual fibres. Matrix and fibre direction control composite performance.

Applications and selection

  • Glass-fibre reinforced plastic tanks/pipes in verified service, textiles and electrical laminates.

Limitations and precautions

  • Glass fibre alone is not a complete FRP chemical barrier; resin, liner, temperature and fabrication govern suitability. Avoid fibre dust/contact.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Glass fibre એટલે બારીક glass filaments, જે reinforcement, fabric તથા સંબંધિત productsમાં વપરાય છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • Silica-based રચનામાં CaO, Al2O3 તથા અન્ય oxides; પરંપરાગત E-glassમાં B2O3 હોઈ શકે, boron-free grades પણ હોય.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • વજનની સરખામણીમાં tensile strength સારી; યોગ્ય grades electrically insulating. એકલ fibre brittle. Composite performance matrix તથા દિશા પર આધારિત.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • ચકાસેલી serviceમાં glass-fibre reinforced plastic tank/pipe, textiles તથા electrical laminates.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • Glass fibre એકલું સંપૂર્ણ FRP chemical barrier નથી; resin, liner, temperature તથા fabrication મહત્વનાં. Fibre dust/contact ટાળો.

body.en:
Definition

Glass wool is a porous mat of fine, generally discontinuous glass fibres that traps gas and reduces heat/sound transfer.

Composition

  • Glass-forming oxides such as SiO2, Na2O, CaO and other modifiers, often recycled glass, with a product-specific binder.

Properties and explanation

  • Low bulk density, low effective k when dry, acoustic absorption; binder and facing set some service/fire limits.

Applications and selection

  • Pipe/building/equipment insulation in rated conditions; unlike continuous glass reinforcement, the primary role is insulation.

Limitations and precautions

  • Moisture/compression can impair performance; fibres irritate skin/eyes/airways. Follow manufacturer PPE and do not disturb unidentified old insulation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Glass wool બારીક સામાન્ય રીતે discontinuous glass fibresની porous ચાદર છે, જે gas અટકાવી heat/sound transfer ઘટાડે છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • SiO2, Na2O, CaO તથા modifiers જેવા glass oxides, ઘણી વાર recycled glass અને product-specific binder.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • ઓછી bulk density, સૂકું હોય ત્યારે ઓછી effective k, acoustic absorption; binder/facingથી service/fire limits બદલાય.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Rated conditionsમાં pipe/building/equipment insulation; continuous reinforcementથી જુદું, મુખ્ય કામ insulation.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • ભેજ/compressionથી performance ઘટે; fibres skin/eyes/airwaysમાં irritation કરે. Manufacturer PPE અનુસરો અને અજ્ઞાત જૂનું insulation ન ખોલો.

body.en:
Definition

Porcelain is a dense, vitrified ceramic commonly made from kaolin/clay, feldspar and silica.

Composition

  • An illustrative unfired batch is kaolin50%, feldspar25%, quartz25% by mass. Firing forms glassy and crystalline phases, often mullite; the fired composition is not simply unchanged raw powders.

Properties and explanation

  • Hard, low porosity when well vitrified, chemically durable and a good electrical insulator, but brittle. Glaze and body quality matter.

Applications and selection

  • Electrical insulators, chemical ware, sanitary and laboratory items.

Limitations and precautions

  • Impact/thermal shock and inappropriate chemical exposure can crack or attack the body/glaze; not all porcelain is chemically interchangeable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Porcelain સામાન્ય રીતે kaolin/clay, feldspar અને silicaથી બનેલું dense vitrified ceramic છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • ઉદાહરણરૂપ unfired batch: kaolin50%, feldspar25%, quartz25% mass. Firingથી glassy તથા ઘણી વાર mullite જેવી crystalline phases બને; fired product મૂળ powders જેવો જ નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Hard, સારી vitrificationમાં ઓછી porosity, chemical durability અને સારી electrical insulation; છતાં brittle. Glaze/body quality મહત્વની.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Electrical insulator, chemical ware, sanitary તથા laboratory items.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • Impact, thermal shock કે અયોગ્ય chemicalથી body/glazeમાં crack/attack થાય; દરેક porcelain chemical રીતે સમાન નથી.

body.en:
Illustrative solved problem

  1. Same plane wall:A=2 m², L=0.10 m, ΔT=50K. Assume dry k=0.04 and wet k=0.08 W/(m·K); values are hypothetical.
  2. Dry:Qdot=0.04×2×50/0.10=40 W. Wet:Qdot=0.08×2×50/0.10=80 W.
  3. Doubling effective k doubles this wall heat rate under the stated assumptions. Real moisture effects need product/test data.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

q.en: Why does wet insulation perform poorly?

a.en: Water replacing trapped gas often raises effective conductivity and can promote corrosion beneath insulation.
a.gu: Trapped gasની જગ્યાએ પાણી આવતાં effective k વધે અને અંદર corrosion પણ થઈ શકે.

q.en: Glass fibre and glass wool:same purpose?
q.gu: Glass Fibre અને Glass Woolનું કામ સમાન?

a.en: Continuous glass fibre often reinforces composites; glass wool is a porous fibre mat mainly for thermal/acoustic insulation.
a.gu: Continuous glass fibre reinforcementમાં; porous glass wool મુખ્યત્વે thermal/acoustic insulationમાં.

q.en: Why choose borosilicate over ordinary glass?

a.en: Its lower expansion improves thermal-shock performance in suitable service, but it remains brittle and chemically limited.
a.gu: ઓછા expansionથી thermal-shock performance સુધરે; છતાં brittle અને chemical limitsવાળું.
